title: Bias-isolated AA bound states at the smallest twist
hypothesis: At m=4 the narrowest top-manifold band is AA-confined; an interlayer bias V can push one layer's AA states out of the manifold and open a gap on both sides.
implementation_plan: Scan V and tp at m=3 with kagome_core to find bands isolated by >= 0.01 t
Refine the best region with a local search, then confirm at m=4
Ablate flux and slide to test whether the mechanism is AA confinement

target_rubrics.description: Finds a band isolated by >= 0.01 t with gap/width above 100 (combined_score > 2)

notes_for_agent: The evaluator re-solves the parameters you return; only the parameter dict matters for the score.
